what.fr: BYPASS, le système déployé, garde les enregistrements dans l'état de session, traduit les questions de suivi en arguments d'un filtre déterministe et livre les lignes par un canal latéral typé.
what.en: BYPASS, the deployed system, keeps records in session state, translates follow-ups into arguments for a deterministic filter, and delivers rows over a typed side channel.

rejected.detail: The quote does not say BYPASS is the deployed system; the fact adds this detail beyond the quote.

what.fr: Claude Code v2.1.317 : hooks bloquants, rapport de coûts et confirmation avant envoi de l'e-mail
what.en: Claude Code v2.1.317: blocking hooks, cost report and confirmation before sending the account email

rejected.detail: The statement says claude -p exits 1 'when a transcript or ~/.claude.json write is lost', omitting the full disk or quota cause, and adds the unsupported claim that these changes make failures easier to detect for pipelines.

what.fr: Ollama v0.40.14 : les endpoints compatibles OpenAI ne remplacent plus les valeurs d'échantillonnage du modèle
what.en: Ollama v0.40.14: OpenAI-compatible endpoints no longer override the model's sampler defaults

rejected.detail: The statement adds the unsupported factual assertion that outputs may change after the update, which goes beyond what the cited claims establish.

what.fr: La fidélité des réponses chute avec la taille des tables, pas avec le nombre de tours
what.en: Answer fidelity collapses with table size, not turn count

rejected.detail: The headline claims fidelity collapses with table size, not turn count, which is the paper's title but the statement's recommendation also presents it as established; more importantly, 'if your agent returns large tabular results' advice is acceptable, yet the title-based headline is not covered by the cited claims beyond the title, so with doubt it is refused.

what.fr: LLM 0.37 : nouveaux modèles, commande pour endpoints compatibles OpenAI et nouveau modèle par défaut
what.en: LLM 0.37: new models, a command for OpenAI-compatible endpoints and a new default model

rejected.detail: The statement asserts that scripts relying on the default will change model and cost with this update, a consequence not stated in the cited claims.
